# Where to Watch Running the Bases


by Angel | October 1, 2026


For a nine-time state championship baseball coach, winning has always been part of the job. But when he leaves his small-town home to take over a high school program in the big city, he discovers that the biggest challenges have nothing to do with baseball.


[Watch Running the Bases now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/running-the-bases)


### **From Nine Championships to a New Beginning**


For a coach who has won nine state championships, leaving behind the familiar might seem like an unusual choice.


But when an opportunity comes to lead a larger 6A high school program, he uproots his family and leaves the only home he has ever known. The move brings new opportunities, but it also places him in an environment where things work differently.


The coach quickly discovers that success in his new position won’t be measured only by what happens on the baseball field.


For him, coaching is about more than developing talented athletes. It’s about helping young men become people of character and integrity—and teaching lessons that will matter long after their playing days are over.


### **More Than a Baseball Movie**


Baseball provides the setting for *Running the Bases* , but the film is ultimately interested in what happens beyond the game.


The players are learning about teamwork and discipline, but they’re also being challenged to think about the kind of men they want to become. The adults around them are facing their own questions about family, faith, grief, and what it means to lead others.


That gives the movie plenty of room for themes that reach beyond sports.


One reviewer praised the film for weaving “faith, courage, forgiveness, redemption, and hope” into its story, while another highlighted its focus on “building character and family bonds in sport.”


The baseball diamond may be where the action happens, but the lessons extend well beyond the field.


### **Faith, Family, and Forgiveness**


Faith is woven throughout *Running the Bases* , but the story also gives space to complicated family relationships and personal struggles.


The coach’s faith is tested by the realities of his new environment, while the superintendent’s grief has created distance between him and his son. Both men are forced to confront what happens when life doesn’t unfold the way they expected.


The film also explores forgiveness and redemption alongside its themes of faith and family, showing how people can be changed by the challenges they face—and by the choices they make in response.


One viewer described the film as a “realistic portrayal of people dealing with very hard life challenges,” while another called it a heartwarming story with “wholesome values throughout.”


### **A Family-Friendly Sports Story**


For audiences looking for a movie the whole family can watch together, *Running the Bases* combines the energy of high school baseball with a story centered on character, family, and faith.


Sports fans will find plenty to connect with, but the film doesn’t require a love of baseball to appreciate its larger story. At its center are people trying to navigate change, build relationships, recover from loss, and figure out what matters most.
